t: This is the site of the Mermaid Theatre, at Blackfriars in the City of London, where Puddle Dock and Curriers' Alley once met. It was the first theatre built in the City since the time of Shakespeare. It was also one of the first new theatres to abandon the traditional stage layout: a single tier of seats surrounded the stage on three sides. It was designed by Ove Arup, the Anglo-Danish engineer who founded the firm Arup and is considered among the foremost structural engineers of his time.
